"""Run existing native acceptance workflows with read-only BS1 observations."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'scripts'))
import s760_runtime

class ObservedRuntime(s760_runtime.NativeRuntime):
    def _start(self,timeout):
        folder=self.config.state_dir.resolve()/'bs1-observer'
        folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
        wrapper=folder/'wrapper.lua'
        observer=folder/'observer.lua'
        shutil.copyfile(HERE/'observer.lua',observer)
        wrapper.write_text('dofile('+json.dumps((ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.lua').as_posix())+')\n'
                           +'dofile('+json.dumps(observer.as_posix())+')\n',encoding='utf-8')
        launch=subprocess.Popen
        def observed(command,**kwargs):
            command=list(command)
            command[command.index('-autoboot_script')+1]=str(wrapper)
            kwargs['env']['BS1_OBSERVER_DIR']=folder.as_posix()
            return launch([*command,'-log'],**kwargs)
        self.observation_folder=folder
        self.snapshot_count=0
        with patch('s760_runtime.subprocess.Popen',side_effect=observed):
            super()._start(timeout)

    def request(self,operation,**kwargs):
        result=super().request(operation,**kwargs)
        if operation=='frames':
            self.snapshot_count+=1
            tag=f'frame-{self.snapshot_count:02}'
            temporary=self.observation_folder/'snapshot-request.tmp'
            temporary.write_text(tag,encoding='ascii')
            temporary.replace(self.observation_folder/'snapshot-request.txt')
            deadline=time.monotonic()+10
            while not (self.observation_folder/(tag+'.json')).exists():
                if self.process.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('Observer process stopped')
                if time.monotonic()>deadline:raise TimeoutError('Read-only snapshot timed out')
                time.sleep(.02)
        return result

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--workflow',choices=('stereo','scsi-save'),required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    workflow=ROOT/'scripts'/('verify_native_sampling_input.py' if args.workflow=='stereo' else 'verify_native_scsi_save.py')
    files=[Path(__file__),HERE/'observer.lua',workflow,ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.py',ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.lua',ROOT/'mame-source/mames760.exe',ROOT/'S760224.IMG',ROOT/'roms/BOOT/Roland_S-760_v1.11.BIN']
    identity={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in files}
    sys.argv=[str(workflow),'--state-dir',str(args.output.resolve())]
    if args.workflow=='stereo':
        sys.argv+=['--blank-disk',str(ROOT/'docs/ic20-hle-findings/chatGPT-work/media-verification-20261012-065549/formatted.img')]
    with patch.object(s760_runtime,'NativeRuntime',ObservedRuntime):
        runpy.run_path(str(workflow),run_name='__main__')
    assert all(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==identity[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))] for p in files), 'Input changed during observation'
    (args.output/'observer-identities.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2)+'\n')

if __name__=='__main__':main()

-- Read-only observations of original firmware. No guest writes or forced events.
local json=require('json')
local machine=manager.machine
local cpu=machine.devices[':maincpu']
local p,r=cpu.spaces['program'],cpu.spaces['register']
local ram,banks
for name,index in pairs(machine.devices[':'].items) do
 if name:match('/m_banked_ram$') then ram=emu.item(index) end
 if name:match('/m_bank_regs$') then banks=emu.item(index) end
end
assert(ram and ram.count==0x100000 and banks)
local folder=assert(os.getenv('BS1_OBSERVER_DIR'))
local log=assert(io.open(folder..'/observations.jsonl','w'))
local inspecting=false
local function word(a) return banks:read(a-0x100)|(banks:read(a-0xff)<<8) end
local function physical(a,fetch) return (word((fetch and 0x100 or 0x108)+2*(a>>14))<<10)+(a&0x3fff) end
local function raw(a,n)
 local out={}
 for i=0,n-1 do
  local x=physical((a+i)&0xffff,false)
  if x>=ram.count then return nil end
  out[#out+1]=string.format('%02x',ram:read(x))
 end
 return table.concat(out)
end
local function context(kind)
 local row={kind=kind,seconds=machine.time:as_double(),pc=cpu.state['CURPC'].value,psw=cpu.state['PSW'].value,selectors={},registers={}}
 for a=0x100,0x10e,2 do row.selectors[string.format('%04x',a)]=word(a) end
 for _,a in ipairs({0x18,0x1c,0x1e,0x28,0x2a,0x2c,0x2e,0x42,0x48,0x4a,0x4c,0x4e,0x58,0xb8,0xba,0xbc,0xbe,0xda}) do row.registers[string.format('%02x',a)]=r:read_u16(a) end
 row.physical_pc=physical(row.pc,true)
 row.stack=raw(r:read_u16(0x18),16)
 row.target_state=raw(0x3620,0x30)
 row.descriptor=raw(r:read_u16(0x48),16)
 return row
end
local function emit(row) log:write(json.stringify(row)..'\n');log:flush() end
local call_count=0
local returns={}
local examples={}
local taps={}
-- Tap handles remove themselves at Lua garbage collection; retain the handles.
_G.bs1_observer_taps=taps
taps[#taps+1]=p:install_write_tap(0x102,0x103,'bs1-call',function(a,d,m)
 if inspecting then return end
 local before=word(0x102)
 local sp=r:read_u16(0x18)
 local target=r:read_u16(0x1e)
 local entry=d==0x3b and target>=0x73d6 and target<0x8000 and cpu.state['CURPC'].value==0xce22
 local returning=before==0x3b and cpu.state['CURPC'].value==0xce36 and returns[sp]
 if entry or returning then
  -- POP increments SP before the selector write tap fires: all 12 saved
  -- bytes are already popped when CE36 is observed.
  if entry then returns[sp+12]=target else target=returns[sp];returns[sp]=nil end
  call_count=call_count+1
  inspecting=true
  local row=context('selector-write');row.before=before;row.value=d;row.routine=target;row.direction=entry and 'entry' or 'return'
  if entry and target==0x7592 then
   local ptr=r:read_u16(0x48)
   if ptr>=0x4000 and ptr<0x8000 then
    row.sender_descriptor_fixed_page=ram:read_block((0x2cc<<10)+(ptr&0x3fff),16):gsub('.',function(c) return string.format('%02x',string.byte(c)) end)
   end
  end
  local key=string.format('%04x-%s-%s',target,row.direction,(row.sender_descriptor_fixed_page or ''):sub(1,4))
  examples[key]=(examples[key] or 0)+1
  if examples[key]<=12 then emit(row) end
  inspecting=false
 end
end)
local commands=0
taps[#taps+1]=p:install_write_tap(0xe404,0xe405,'bs1-spc-control',function(a,d,m)
 if inspecting or physical(a,false)~=0x102404 then return end
 commands=commands+1
 if commands<=2000 then
  inspecting=true local row=context('spc-control');row.value=d;row.mask=m;emit(row);inspecting=false
 end
end)
local ranges={{0x03d3e,0x05c80},{0xdabe4,0xe435c},{0xe435e,0xe7c00},{0xe8010,0xec000},{0xec000,0xed338},{0xed3f8,0xf0000},{0xf53d4,0xfc000},{0xfc000,0x100000}}
local writes={}
for i=1,#ranges do writes[i]={count=0,first={}} end
taps[#taps+1]=p:install_write_tap(0x120,0xffff,'bs1-candidate-writes',function(a,d,m)
 if inspecting then return end
 local x=physical(a,false)
 for i,range in ipairs(ranges) do
  if x>=range[1] and x<range[2] then
   local w=writes[i];w.count=w.count+1
   if #w.first<8 then w.first[#w.first+1]={address=a,physical=x,data=d,mask=m,pc=cpu.state['CURPC'].value,fetch_page=word(0x100+2*(cpu.state['CURPC'].value>>14)),seconds=machine.time:as_double()} end
   break
  end
 end
end)
local object_active=false
local object_rows=0
local object_dropped=0
local object_ranges={{0xbe800,0xbe900},{0xc2800,0xc2900},{0xca800,0xca880}}
taps[#taps+1]=p:install_write_tap(0x120,0xffff,'bs1-object-writes',function(a,d,m)
 if inspecting or not object_active then return end
 local x=physical(a,false)
 for i,range in ipairs(object_ranges) do
  if x>=range[1] and x<range[2] then
   if object_rows<20000 then
    inspecting=true;local row=context('object-write');row.object=i;row.physical=x;row.address=a;row.data=d;row.mask=m;row.before=raw(a,2);emit(row);inspecting=false;object_rows=object_rows+1
   else object_dropped=object_dropped+1 end
   break
  end
 end
end)
emu.register_periodic(function()
 if object_active then return end
 local f=io.open(folder..'/observe-objects.txt','r')
 if f then f:close();object_active=true;emit({kind='object-observer-active',seconds=machine.time:as_double()}) end
end)
local seen=''
emu.register_periodic(function()
 local f=io.open(folder..'/snapshot-request.txt','r')
 if not f then return end
 local tag=f:read('*a');f:close()
 if tag==seen or not tag:match('^[%w_-]+$') then return end
 seen=tag;inspecting=true
 local out=assert(io.open(folder..'/'..tag..'.ram','wb'));out:write(ram:read_block(0,ram.count));out:close()
 local row=context('snapshot');row.tag=tag;row.ranges=ranges;row.cpu_writes=writes;row.call_count=call_count;row.spc_controls=commands;row.object_rows=object_rows;row.object_dropped=object_dropped;emit(row)
 local done=assert(io.open(folder..'/'..tag..'.json','w'));done:write(json.stringify(row));done:close()
 inspecting=false
end)
emit({kind='observer-ready',ram_bytes=ram.count,qualification='Read-only save-item snapshots and passthrough CPU write taps. CPU write counts exclude direct DMA; snapshot differences include DMA. No access absence proves ownership.'})
sources.analyze_assignment.py:
"""Qualify ordinary native stereo assignment, Save and fresh-process Load."""
from pathlib import Path
import collections
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import struct

import numpy as np
import pypcode

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def u16(raw, offset):
    return struct.unpack_from('<H', raw, offset)[0]

OBJECTS = [('performance0', 0xbe800, 256), ('patch0', 0xc2800, 256),
           ('partial0', 0xca800, 128), ('sample0', 0xd2800, 48),
           ('sample1', 0xd2830, 48)]
image = (ROOT / 'roms/System/S760224.IMG').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(image).hexdigest() == '3827ed4c46fd48abbec3095266164853033141d7bd15afe8dda0050d00e073cd'
records, runs, snapshots, ram_by_name = {}, {}, [], {}
for run_name, expected in [('save-01', 20), ('cold-01', 5)]:
    work = HERE / run_name
    run = json.loads((work / 'result.json').read_text())
    assert run['source_unchanged']
    assert all(sha(ROOT / path) == value for path, value in run['identities'].items())
    runs[run_name] = run
    rows = [a for a in run['actions'] if 'snapshot' in a]
    assert len(rows) == expected
    for row in rows:
        path = work / f'runtime/bs1-observer/frame-{row["snapshot"]:02}.ram'
        raw = path.read_bytes()
        context = json.loads(path.with_suffix('.json').read_text())
        assert len(raw) == 0x100000 and context['object_dropped'] == 0
        ram_by_name[(run_name, row['name'])] = raw
        objects = {name: raw[base:base + size] for name, base, size in OBJECTS}
        records[(run_name, row['name'])] = objects
        low = context['selectors']['0108'] << 10
        assert u16(raw, low + 0x3616) == 26
        snapshots.append(dict(run=run_name, name=row['name'], context=context,
                              ram_sha256=sha(path), allocation_cursor=26,
                              objects={name: value.hex() for name, value in objects.items()},
                              preview_partial255_hex=raw[0xd2780:0xd2800].hex()))

def saved(name):
    return records[('save-01', name)]

def refs(partial):
    return [u16(partial, n) for n in [0x10, 0x20, 0x30, 0x40]]

baseline = saved('loop-screen')
assert refs(baseline['partial0']) == [65535] * 4
assert refs(saved('partial-left-only')['partial0']) == [0, 65535, 65535, 65535]
stereo = saved('partial-stereo')['partial0']
assert refs(stereo) == [0, 1, 65535, 65535]
assert [stereo[0x14], stereo[0x24]] == [224, 32]
assert baseline['patch0'][0x20:0x78] == bytes([255]) * 88
assert saved('split-before-set')['patch0'][0x20:0x78] == bytes([255]) * 88
assert saved('split-set')['patch0'][0x20:0x78] == bytes(88)
assert baseline['performance0'][0x10:0x30] == bytes([255]) * 32
assert saved('performance-unnamed')['performance0'][0x10:0x30] == bytes([0]) + bytes([255]) * 31
name = b'   :bs1perf     '
assert len(name) == 16
for object_name, named_frame in [('performance0', 'performance-named'),
                                ('patch0', 'patch-named'), ('partial0', 'partial-named')]:
    assert baseline[object_name][0] == 0x7f
    assert saved(named_frame)[object_name][:16] == name
    assert saved('performance-unnamed')[object_name][0] == 0x7f

ready = saved('performance-ready')
for key, value in records.items():
    assert value['sample0'] == baseline['sample0'] and value['sample1'] == baseline['sample1']
    if key[0] == 'cold-01' or key[1] in ['performance-saved', 'after-save']:
        assert value == ready, key
# Cold Load restores the playable hierarchy before any Sample/Partial mode.
# Reserved preview partial255 is still unassigned at the first Perform screen.
cold = ram_by_name[('cold-01', 'perform-screen')]
assert refs(cold[0xd2780:0xd2800]) == [65535] * 4

# Replay every observed CPU store from the baseline. This verifies both the
# captured pre-write values and exact record reconstruction at every snapshot.
trace = [json.loads(line) for line in (HERE / 'save-01/runtime/bs1-observer/observations.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
object_rows = [r for r in trace if r['kind'] == 'object-write']
assert len(object_rows) == 238
mutable = {key: bytearray(value) for key, value in baseline.items()}
by_tag = {f'frame-{a["snapshot"]:02}': a['name'] for a in runs['save-01']['actions'] if 'snapshot' in a}
count = 0
for row in trace:
    if row['kind'] == 'object-write':
        object_name, base, size = OBJECTS[row['object'] - 1]
        offset = row['physical'] - base
        before = u16(mutable[object_name], offset)
        assert before == int.from_bytes(bytes.fromhex(row['before']), 'little')
        assert 0 <= offset < size - 1
        after = (before & (~row['mask'] & 0xffff)) | (row['data'] & row['mask'])
        struct.pack_into('<H', mutable[object_name], offset, after)
        count += 1
    elif row['kind'] == 'snapshot':
        assert row['object_rows'] == count and row['object_dropped'] == 0
        expected = saved(by_tag[row['tag']])
        assert all(bytes(mutable[key]) == value for key, value in expected.items())

ctx = pypcode.Context('MCS96:LE:16:default')
anchors = []
groups = collections.defaultdict(list)
for row in object_rows:
    pc = row['pc']
    page = row['selectors'][f'{0x100 + 2 * (pc >> 14):04x}']
    groups[(page, pc)].append(row)
for (page, pc), rows in groups.items():
    offset = 0x4800 + (page << 10) + (pc & 0x3fff)
    instruction = ctx.disassemble(image[offset:offset + 8], base_address=pc, max_instructions=1).instructions[0]
    assert instruction.mnem in ['ST', 'STB']
    assert all(r['physical_pc'] + 0x4800 == offset for r in rows)
    anchors.append(dict(page=page, pc=pc, file_offset=offset,
                        bytes=image[offset:offset + instruction.length].hex(),
                        instruction=instruction.mnem + ' ' + instruction.body,
                        observed_stores=len(rows)))
assert len(anchors) == 11
mapping = [r for r in object_rows if r['pc'] == 0x86b1]
auxiliary = [r for r in object_rows if r['pc'] == 0x86b4]
def written_byte_addresses(rows):
    return [r['physical'] + (1 if r['mask'] == 0xff00 else 0) for r in rows]
assert written_byte_addresses(mapping) == list(range(0xc2820, 0xc2878))
assert written_byte_addresses(auxiliary) == list(range(0xc2880, 0xc28d8))
assert all(r['data'] == 0 for r in mapping + auxiliary)

disk_path = HERE / 'save-01/saved-performance.img'
disk = disk_path.read_bytes()
assert len(disk) == 737280 and struct.unpack_from('<4H', disk, 0x108) == (1, 1, 1, 2)
disk_records = {}
for (object_name, base, size), offset in zip(OBJECTS, [0x4e00, 0x8e00, 0x10e00, 0x18e00, 0x18e30]):
    raw = disk[offset:offset + size]
    native = ready[object_name]
    differences = [dict(offset=i, native=a, disk=b) for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(native, raw)) if a != b]
    disk_records[object_name] = dict(offset=offset, hex=raw.hex(), native_differences=differences)
    if object_name in ['partial0', 'patch0']:
        assert raw == native
    elif object_name == 'performance0':
        assert differences == [dict(offset=3, native=0x3a, disk=0x80)]
    else:
        expected = bytearray(raw)
        block = u16(raw, 0x28) - 5
        for address in [0x10, 0x14, 0x18, 0x1c, 0x20]:
            struct.pack_into('<I', expected, address,
                             struct.unpack_from('<I', raw, address)[0] + ((8 + 4608 * block) << 8))
        struct.pack_into('<H', expected, 0x28, block)
        assert bytes(expected) == native
        assert u16(raw, 0x2a) == 13

source_path = ROOT / 'docs/ic20-hle-findings/chatGPT-work/bluescsi-feasibility-2026-10-18/stereo-04/captured-stereo.img'
source_disk = source_path.read_bytes()
assert disk[0x2ac00:0x2ac00 + 239616] == source_disk[0x2ac00:0x2ac00 + 239616]
pcm = []
for channel, (period, step) in enumerate([(257, 64), (509, 32)]):
    raw = disk[0x2ac00 + channel * 119808:0x2ac00 + (channel + 1) * 119808]
    values = np.frombuffer(raw, dtype='<i2')[:56719].astype(float)
    phase = int(values[0]) // step + period // 2
    assert np.array_equal(values, ((np.arange(56719) + phase) % period - period // 2) * step)
    assert not any(raw[56719 * 2:])
    pcm.append(dict(channel=channel, frames=56719, allocation_bytes=119808,
                    sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), period=period, step=step, initial_phase=phase))
for run_name in runs:
    wave = (HERE / run_name / 'wave.bin').read_bytes()
    assert len(wave) == 33554432
    assert wave[16:16 + 239616] == disk[0x2ac00:0x2ac00 + 239616]

audios = []
for run_name, names in [('save-01', ['partial-stereo', 'patch-stereo', 'performance-unnamed', 'performance-ready', 'after-save']),
                        ('cold-01', ['cold-performance', 'cold-returned-performance'])]:
    work = HERE / run_name
    for name in names:
        a = np.fromfile(work / (name + '.pcm'), dtype='<f4').reshape(-1, 2)
        tail = np.fromfile(work / (name + '-tail.pcm'), dtype='<f4').reshape(-1, 2)
        assert a.shape == (65536, 2) and tail.shape == (88200, 2)
        assert np.isfinite(a).all() and np.isfinite(tail).all() and not np.any(tail[-44100:])
        assert not np.array_equal(a[:, 0], a[:, 1])
        fits = []
        for channel in range(2):
            v = a[5000:30000, channel].astype(float)
            period, step = pcm[channel]['period'], pcm[channel]['step']
            best = None
            for phase in range(period):
                reference = ((np.arange(len(v)) + phase) % period - period // 2) * step
                gain = float(np.dot(v, reference) / np.dot(reference, reference))
                error = float(np.sqrt(np.mean((v - gain * reference) ** 2)))
                if best is None or error < best['rms_error']:
                    best = dict(channel=channel, phase=phase, gain=gain, rms_error=error,
                                relative_rms_error=error / float(np.sqrt(np.mean(v * v))),
                                correlation=float(np.corrcoef(v, reference)[0, 1]))
            assert best['correlation'] > .999999 and best['relative_rms_error'] < 1e-6
            fits.append(best)
        common = [n for n in range(56719 - 25000 + 1)
                  if all((pcm[c]['initial_phase'] + n) % pcm[c]['period'] == fits[c]['phase'] for c in range(2))]
        assert len(common) == 1
        audios.append(dict(run=run_name, name=name, sha256=sha(work / (name + '.pcm')),
                           tail_sha256=sha(work / (name + '-tail.pcm')), frames=len(a),
                           analysis_window=[5000, 30000], fits=fits,
                           common_source_frame_for_window=common[0], final_second_silent=True))

manual = ROOT / 'Manuals/S-760_OM.pdf'
report = dict(date='2026-10-18', status='BS1 open; native permanent stereo assignment and disk persistence qualified for one recorded pair',
              image_sha256=hashlib.sha256(image).hexdigest(),
              versions={n: importlib.metadata.version(n) for n in ['pypcode', 'numpy', 'Pillow']},
              runs=runs, snapshots=snapshots, object_write_rows=object_rows, store_anchors=anchors,
              trace_summary=dict(rows=len(object_rows), dropped=0, exact_replay=True,
                                 patch_keymap_stores=88, patch_auxiliary_zero_stores=88,
                                 auxiliary_span='patch+80..D7 inclusive; semantic meaning not established'),
              saved_disk=dict(sha256=sha(disk_path), bytes=len(disk), counts=[1, 1, 1, 2], records=disk_records),
              source_fixture=dict(path=str(source_path.relative_to(ROOT)), sha256=sha(source_path)),
              pcm=pcm, audio=audios,
              manual=dict(path=str(manual.relative_to(ROOT)), sha256=sha(manual),
                          pages_one_based={40: 'Patch Split and 88-note range', 48: 'Stereo search in Partial SMT',
                                           50: 'Automatic L32/R32 pan', 141: 'Unnamed sounds cannot be saved/copied/deleted/initialized',
                                           148: 'Sound list', 149: 'Name operation', 290: 'ASCII names', 291: 'CR completes name'}),
              artifact_hashes={f'{r}/{p.name}': sha(p) for r in runs for p in sorted((HERE / r).glob('*.png'))},
              wave_dump_hashes={r: sha(HERE / r / 'wave.bin') for r in runs},
              commands={r: {p.name: json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in sorted((HERE / r).glob('command-*.json'))} for r in runs},
              runtime_identities={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)): sha(p) for p in [ROOT / 'mame-source/src/mame/roland/s760.cpp', ROOT / 'scripts/s760_runtime.py', ROOT / 'scripts/s760_runtime.lua']},
              sources={p.name: p.read_text() for p in [HERE / 'native_assignment.py', HERE / 'probe_base.py', HERE / 'observer.lua', Path(__file__)]},
              limits=['Stock firmware, ordinary mouse/encoder/panel/MIDI actions and read-only snapshots/passthrough write taps only; no forced guest RAM, vectors, registers or PC.',
                      'Native emulator evidence, not physical BlueSCSI or DSP acceptance. Only one existing 44.1 kHz stereo OneShot pair at root key 60.',
